description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [50% Critical (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Machina - 2)] and [Earth Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Machina - 2)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00 for Earth abilities, casts Dual Rush Blade after using two Earth abilities
